key_insight: LeVo 2 improves full-length song generation by combining global planning with fine-grained audio detail, avoiding the usual trade-off between coherence and track-specific realism. It uses a hybrid LLM-Diffusion design plus progressive post-training to produce songs that are more stable, controllable, and melodious.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of generating complete songs that stay coherent over long durations while accurately rendering vocals and accompaniment, and following lyrics/prompt instructions. Existing approaches either lose detailed track information with mixed-token modeling or become too long and less globally consistent with dual-track prediction.
method: Hybrid LLM-Diffusion framework for controllable full-length song generation.
Hierarchical representation modeling to preserve both global structure and fine-grained vocal/accompaniment details.
Progressive post-training to improve stability, musicality, and alignment with lyrics/prompts.
impact: This matters for AI/ML practitioners because it points to a practical way to build higher-quality music generation systems without sacrificing long-range consistency. It may also serve as a template for other generative audio tasks that need both structural planning and detailed rendering.
visual_elements: Side-by-side comparison of mixed-token vs dual-track vs LeVo 2 pipelines.

paper_title: LeVo 2: Stable and Melodious Song Generation via Hierarchical Representation Modeling and Progressive Post-Training
paper_authors: Shun Lei, Huaicheng Zhang, Dapeng Wu, Yaoxun Xu, Lishi Zuo
